# A test reads a prop of a node whose library body the optimizer would splice
# for a fold it unlocks -- html's ui.badge picks its class from `variant` --
# so the read is answered from the call as written: spliced first, `#kind`
# was the span html draws a badge with, which names no `value`, and the read
# folded to "".

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Kind {
    name string
}

struct Item {
    kinds list[Kind]
}

component card ui.node {
    var item option[Item] = Item{kinds=[Kind{name="leaf"}, Kind{name="stone"}]}
    if item != null {
        ui.hbox {
            for var k = item.kinds {
                ui.badge #kind(value=string.upper(k.name))
            }
        }
    }
}

component held ui.node {
    card #inner()
}

func testABadgeOfAnOptionIsRead(t test.Test, c held) {
    t.assert(c.inner.kind[0].value == "LEAF")
    t.assert(c.inner.kind[1].value == "STONE")
}
